text:
Eli Jones: Hey folks — I'm a new hire trying to get into the private VPC to hit internal services but SSH to the bastion just times out. Followed the onboarding doc (MacBook Pro, macOS 13). VPN says connected via Okta. Any quick checks?
Anya Patel: welcome! quick Qs: what client shows as connected (okta browser plugin vs okta-SSO app)? can you paste the output of `netstat -nr | grep -E \"default|10\\.|172\\.|192\\.168\"`?
Eli Jones: using Okta Gateway (browser SSO + local agent). here's a redacted route summary:  
```
default            192.0.2.1        UGSc           50        0     en0
10.0.0.0/8         169.254.1.1      UGSc            0        0     ppp0
```
I also tried `ssh bastion` -> timeout.
Connor Lee: that route for 10.0/8 via 169.254 looks odd — seems like the split-tunnel isn't pushing corp routes to your machine. two quick things: 1) check that the Okta Gateway session applied the corp route (you should see 10.0/8 pointing to the VPN adapter), 2) try traceroute to bastion IP to see where it drops.
Eli Jones: traceroute shows first hop to VPN gw then nothing: `traceroute 10.0.5.12` -> stops after hop 2.
Anya Patel: likely a split-tunnel policy where the client only proxies certain domains, not the full VPC CIDR. For new hires we usually add a static route locally while infra fixes your session: on mac run: `sudo route -n add -net 10.0.0.0/8 <VPN_GW_IP>` (replace <VPN_GW_IP> with the gateway from your ppp/tun). Example: `sudo route -n add -net 10.0.0.0/8 169.254.1.1`
Connor Lee: also check SG + bastion target: bastion only accepts SSH from the corp CIDR and the SSM tunnel. If you still can't, use the SSM jump session in the console (requires your IAM tag). I can check your IAM if you want.
infra-bot: Checked Eli Jones' IAM tags — corp-ssh-access: pending. Please ping infra to approve SSO role binding.
Eli Jones: ohh I didn't realize there's an IAM approval step. How do I request it?
Anya Patel: put a request in #eng-infra with `@infra` and include your user email and employee ID. I'll pre-approve on my side to speed it up.
Eli Jones: tried adding the route and updated ssh config with ProxyJump but still getting denied (connection reset). snippet I used: 
```
Host bastion
  HostName 10.0.5.12
  User eli
  ProxyJump jump.corp:22
```
(This was just a test)
Connor Lee: don't ProxyJump to a hostname that's not resolvable on your client. Use the bastion private IP once the route is in place. Also make sure your SSH key is uploaded to the console or that SSM session manager is enabled for your account.
okta-bot: MFA required for Okta Gateway re-auth. Eli Jones, please complete the browser MFA prompt to refresh routes.
Eli Jones: did the MFA re-auth, re-added the route with the VPN gw IP, and retried ssh -> it connected! 
Anya Patel: awesome — sounds like there were two issues: 1) IAM role not yet bound (infra will approve), 2) split-tunnel needed a manual local route until Okta push policy applied. We'll add a checklist step to the new-hire doc to re-auth after install so the corp routes land.
Eli Jones: huge thanks everyone — up and running. tagging this thread so others can search for the fix: re-auth Okta + add temporary 10.0/8 route if bastion unreachable. :tada:
